beats.headline: Hired with the rest
beats.text: Subject is the skeleton disc jockey of the Penis Parade, hired in the same transaction as thirteen male dancers and a crocodilian youth: one coupon of a hundred thousand gold, two floors, the whole crew. Only the men of the Parade were eligible; the women of the other rooms were left behind. Subject transferred to the front door of the crawlers' personal space the moment the contract cleared. Damascus Steel named him specifically when he set the price, and stayed out of the deal himself.

beats.headline: The announcer, not the act
beats.text: Subject is a skeletal Bard, level ninety, working as announcer and disc jockey for one of the club’s establishments rather than performing in it. He also takes mercenary contracts. The two careers turn out to require the same skill, which is holding a room’s attention while something else happens in it.

beats.headline: A spell called Conscript
beats.text: Observed in the mercenary arcade. Subject is a Skin Skellie, able to grow flesh and organs, and his off-stage voice is that of a soft-spoken professor. Bards take patrons; his was Astrid, and is now Carl. He is practising a military charm that works only on the weak-minded and lasts, on the weak, more or less forever. It is called Conscript, the spell factions use to enslave crawlers on the ninth floor. He has some of Carl's own spells too, he says, and some are more powerful than Carl's.
